# imGuIZMO.quat boundary

Repository: https://github.com/BrutPitt/imGuIZMO.quat.git

Audited commit: `23c8e689ec6b7d9bbfe5231a8d33ae946e2e65be`

License: BSD 2-Clause. Integrated scope: `imguizmo_quat/imGuIZMOquat.cpp` and headers compiled as the editor-private `uve_editor_imguizmo` target against UVE's existing pinned Dear ImGui. The widget is used by the primitive-only camera-orientation adapter; UVE's native object transform gizmo remains authoritative for scene manipulation. The repository's separate `libs/imgui` submodule is intentionally not fetched.
